Opp . ... on 14 November, 2024 Author: Rajesh Shankar Bench: Rajesh Shankar In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi A.B.A. No.6880 of 2024 ----- Bhola Sao @ Bhola Saw, S/o Mahadev Saw, R/o 390 A, Ashram Road, P.O.-Hazaribagh, P.S.-Sadar, District- Hazaribagh. .......... Petitioner. -Versus- The State of Jharkhand .......... Opp. Party. ----- Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Shankar ----- For the Petitioner : Mr. Mohit Prakash, Advocate For the State : Mr. P.D. Agrawal, Spl. P.P. ----- Order No.03 Date: 14.11.2024 1. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with G (Fa) Case No.141 of 2011 registered under Sections 16(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
texts.facts: The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with G (Fa) Case No.141 of 2011 registered under Sections 16(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
texts.arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case and has not committed any offence as alleged in the prosecution report, on perusal of which it will itself be evident that the co-accused-Badri Prasad is the proprietor of M/S Laxmi Food Products. The said firm has been prosecuted with an allegation of selling misbranded sattu of 'Swastik' brand. The petitioner has no concern with the said firm as he is neither the proprietor nor the employee of the same.
